items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: They played it for us and Lucille said she's got to get it

ctx.x: They are reminiscing. And Barney and Dottie told Lucille about how they enjoyed
the tape. They played it for us and Lucille said she's got to get it, she's got to get it.
Yes, she's got to get one.
